summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Qudsia Begum, who died in 1765. She was a wife of Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah and the mother of emperor Ahmad Shah Bahadur. The note describes her as an administrator who served as de facto regent of India from 1748 to 1754.
one_line: Qudsia Begum (died 1765) was a Mughal royal consort, mother of Ahmad Shah Bahadur, and de facto regent of India from 1748 to 1754.
key_facts: Qudsia Begum was a wife of Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah.
Qudsia Begum was the mother of Mughal emperor Ahmad Shah Bahadur.
Qudsia Begum served as de facto regent of India from 1748 to 1754.
